name: Austin Zoo
tagline: Hill Country rescue-style zoo — smaller, kinder pace than mega zoos.

practical.ticket_note: Rescue zoo (not a full AZA megafauna collection) — set expectations: big cats, bears, hoofstock, tortoises; no elephants/hippos/giraffes expected.
